answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 51 identities per epoch. Audits are published in canyon, queued in sonnet, and opal publishes the wait time. A farm of 270 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1334 identities would post 3989 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
